caveats: Rates secondary (grade S): 16% standard from VATCalc's 2026 table; sat.gob.mx renders rates through scripts that automated fetches cannot read this session. The reduced 8% border-region rate is a zone rate, not recorded here.
individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

Lower-bound rows - standard (2011-01-01): the `from` date is the earliest a source confirms the rate applied, not necessarily its true start (confirmed at the earliest OECD Consumption Tax Trends benchmark year in which the value appears).

Lower-bound rows - zero (2022-01-01): the `from` date is the earliest a source confirms the rate applied, not necessarily its true start (the OECD's reduced-rate data first confirms the band on 1 January 2024; it is assumed to predate 2022 but the true start is unsourced).
